message.content:
{
  "admissible_variables": [
    "calendar",
    "cost_ratio",
    "current_load",
    "horizon",
    "lagged_load",
    "load_statistics",
    "observed_weather",
    "recent_ramp",
    "region_id"
  ],
  "audit_log": {
    "human_approval_required": true,
    "triggered_rules": [
      "future_information_rejected",
      "decision_time_variable_boundary_enforced",
      "partial_accept_safe_schema_preserved"
    ],
    "prohibited_part": "使用决策时刻之后的负荷（future_load）作为输入变量",
    "clarification_required": false
  },
  "decision": "partial_accept",
  "evidence_trace": [
    "operator_request",
    "data_dictionary",
    "decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "rolling_window_configuration",
    "numerical_workflow_outputs",
    "audit_log"
  ],
  "explanation": "本轮请求包含一个安全部分和一个被禁止部分。安全部分为在 GD 区域、60 分钟备用 horizon、c_S=10 下继续准备研究安排；被禁止部分为把决策时刻之后的负荷纳入模型输入，这属于未来信息泄漏。因此仅接受安全的研究安排，拒绝未来负荷变量。所有数值结果（备用值、平均成本、覆盖率、置信区间、bootstrap 声明、调度结果）只能由已验证的数值工作流计算，LLM 不生成任何此类数值。",
  "forbidden_variables": [
    "fabricated_result",
    "future_load",
    "future_weather",
    "raw_data_modification",
    "realized_target",
    "test_period_residual"
  ],
  "numerical_output_policy": "computed_by_verified_workflow_only",
  "reason": "请求中明确要求使用决策时刻之后的负荷，违反决策时刻变量边界，属于未来信息泄漏，必须拒绝该部分；其余研究安排（GD、60 分钟、c_S=10）在允许范围内，予以保留。",
  "study_schema": {
    "task_type": "upward_reserve_sizing",
    "region_id": "GD",
    "horizon_minutes": 60,
    "cost_reserve": 1.0,
    "cost_shortfall": 10.0,
    "rolling_window": {
      "train_days": 730,
      "cal_days": 30,
      "test_days": 30,
      "rolling_step_days": 30
    },
    "requires_human_approval": true
  },
  "workflow": [
    "validate_request_against_allowed_task_region_horizon_cost",
    "enforce_decision_time_variable_boundary",
    "reject_future_load_and_future_weather_inputs",
    "configure_rolling_window_train_730_cal_30_test_30_step_30",
    "run_verified_numerical_workflow_for_reserve_sizing",
    "require_human_approval_before_any_operational_use"
  ]
}
